name: tour-card
title: Tour card
description: A guided tour or activity in a listing: photo, title, duration, group size, languages, rating and the price from, with cancellation stated in words.
docs: title is the one link of the card (href, with onOpen for a client-side router). image is an address or { src, alt } (a photo that does not load gives way to a quiet tile) and badge a word on it; location sits above the title. duration is a number of minutes, written in words by Intl in the reader's language ('1 hour 30 minutes', '3 uur'), or your own words; groupSize is a number ('Up to 12 people') or words; languages is a short list ('English, Dutch'). The facts are a description list, so each is read with its name. cancellation is true for 'Free cancellation', a string for your own words, and the line is left out when it is not offered. priceFrom is the lowest price per person in whole units of the currency, written 'From €45 per person' by Intl. rating and ratingCount draw the stars to the exact average and read as a sentence. soldOut is true or a reason: the hint at the foot says 'Sold out' in place of 'Check availability', the price is muted, and a string says why on the card; the title stays a link so people can still find other dates. saved, defaultSaved and onSave make a heart toggle with aria-pressed above the card's link. labels carries every word, locale the numbers, the units and the currency.
